command:
cd /app && ls -la merged_users.parquet conflicts.json && python3 -c "
import json
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
print('--- dtypes ---')
print(df.dtypes)
print('--- columns ---')
print(list(df.columns))
print('--- rows (sorted) ---')
print(df.sort_values('user_id').to_string())
print('unique users:', df.user_id.nunique(), 'rows:', len(df))
assert df.user_id.is_unique, 'user_id duplicated'
assert str(df.user_id.dtype).startswith('int'), 'user_id not integer'
assert list(df.columns) == ['user_id','name','email','created_date','status']
assert df.created_date.str.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$').all(), 'bad date format'
assert set(df.user_id) == {101,102,103,104}, 'unexpected user set'

report = json.load(open('/app/conflicts.json'))
print('--- conflicts.json ---')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
assert report['total_conflicts'] == len(report['conflicts']), 'conflict count mismatch'
for c in report['conflicts']:
    assert set(c) == {'user_id','field','values','selected'}, c
    top = next(c['values'][s] for s in ['source_a','source_b','source_c'] if s in c['values'])
    assert c['selected'] == top, c
    assert len(set(c['values'].values())) > 1, c
print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
"
